vendor: Constellation1 Inc. (operator of offrs.com; site hosted by Constellation Data Solutions, Inc.; part of Constellation Real Estate Group / Constellation Software Inc.)
product_family: Offrs.com is an AI-assisted predictive seller-lead generation platform for real estate agents and brokers. Sub-products: Territory Builder (exclusive zip-code territory access), Lead Feed (guaranteed monthly predictive seller leads), Lead Capture (landing-page/widget lead capture), and an 'AI Agents' conversational engagement layer powered by third-party platform raia.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on offrs.com or on Constellation1 Inc.'s own privacy policy. The ultimate parent, Constellation Software Inc., states on its own separate trust center: 'Security is one of our highest priorities here at Constellation Software Inc.' and lists SOC 2 Type 2 - but that page is on a different corporate domain (trust.helloconstellation.com) and does not name offrs.com, Constellation1, or Constellation Real Estate Group. Constellation Software is a decentralized holding company of 1,000+ autonomously-operated businesses, so this cannot be attributed to the offrs.com product without direct vendor confirmation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Same as SOC 2: ISO 27001 is listed on the parent Constellation Software Inc. trust center (a different domain), not on offrs.com or constellation1.com. No public evidence this extends to the offrs.com product.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Constellation1's privacy policy grants data-subject rights ('access, correction, deletion, opt-out of targeted advertising, opt-out of sales, restrict processing, object, withdraw consent, and file complaints') but this language is framed around US state privacy laws (CCPA-style); no explicit GDPR mechanism (EU representative, Art. 27, SCCs, lawful-basis language) was found on the vendor's own pages, despite the offrs.com lead form offering a Germany (🇩🇪) phone-country option.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention on any vendor-domain page. Not applicable: Offrs is a real estate lead-generation product and does not appear to collect or process PHI.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a PCI DSS attestation on any offrs.com or Constellation1 page.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor-domain pages.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-management-system certification, despite the product's core predictive-analytics and 'AI Agents' features.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor-domain pages.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable - Offrs is a consumer/agent-facing real estate marketing product, not sold to federal government agencies.

privacy.ai_training_note: Offrs.com's footer credits 'Powered by AI Agents from raia', a third-party AI agent platform (raiaai.com) embedded for lead engagement (chat/SMS/email/voice). Raia's own marketing site states its Agent Co-Pilot is 'designed to work within your existing processes, ensuring that your data remains secure and is never used for external model training' - but this is raia's claim about raia, not a commitment independently published on offrs.com's or Constellation1's own privacy policy, which does not address AI/ML training use at all. Net: unconfirmed at the vendor (offrs.com) level.
privacy.data_region: Not specified on any vendor page. Company address in the offrs.com footer is 11350 McCormick Road EP3, Suite 200, Hunt Valley, MD 21031 (USA), suggesting US-based processing, but no explicit data-residency or region commitment was found.

security.name: Encryption in transit / at rest
security.value: Constellation1's privacy policy (the entity governing offrs.com) states it has 'implemented technical, administrative, and physical security measures... including the encryption of sensitive information,' but does not specify TLS version, at-rest encryption scope, or key management details.

security.name: Security disclaimer
security.value: Policy explicitly disclaims guarantee: 'no security measure is perfect' and information transmitted via the internet 'cannot be guaranteed to be 100% secure.'

security.name: Third-party processors
security.value: Personal data (identifiers, network activity, geolocation) is shared with 'Vendors' acting as processors, including for targeted/cross-context behavioral advertising. Each service provider is contractually required to 'use reasonable security procedures and practices.'

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Personal information is retained 'only as long as reasonably necessary to carry out the purposes for which We originally collected it,' with exceptions for legal, tax, and fraud-monitoring obligations.

security.name: Independent certification (product level)
security.value: None publicly documented for offrs.com or Constellation1. The ultimate parent, Constellation Software Inc., lists SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001, and HIPAA monitoring on a separate corporate trust center, but that page does not name offrs.com or confirm scope extends to this product.

products.name: Territory Builder
products.data_scope: Homeowner contact and property data by zip code, described as '250+ points of data on homeowners.'
products.notes: Grants an agent exclusive access to a zip-code territory for predictive seller leads.

products.name: Lead Feed
products.data_scope: Predictive analytics output (likelihood-to-list scores) plus homeowner contact info within the subscribed territory.
products.notes: Vendor guarantees a minimum monthly lead volume per pricing tier; territory auto-expands at no extra cost if the guarantee is unmet.

products.name: Lead Capture
products.data_scope: Visitor-submitted contact-form data (name, phone, address, home-selling intent).
products.notes: Feeds captured leads into the agent's sales funnel alongside predictive seller signals.

products.name: AI Agents (powered by raia)
products.data_scope: Lead conversation content across chat, SMS, email, and voice channels.
products.notes: Third-party AI platform (raia, raiaai.com) is embedded to qualify and engage inbound leads; not an in-house Offrs/Constellation1 AI system.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription, tiered by territory size / guaranteed lead volume. Pricing is not published; sales is gated behind a 'Let's Talk' contact form.
compare.data_residency: Not specified (likely US-based given Hunt Valley, MD corporate address; no explicit commitment found).

flags: Host/parent-vs-vendor cert ambiguity: the ultimate parent, Constellation Software Inc., publishes SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, and ISO 27001 on its own trust center (trust.helloconstellation.com), but Constellation Software is a decentralized holding company of 1,000+ autonomously-run software businesses and that trust center does not name offrs.com, Constellation1, or Constellation Real Estate Group. Do not surface the parent's badges as offrs.com's own certifications without direct vendor confirmation.

Direct fetch of offrs.com's own privacy/ToS/about pages (tos_privacy.cfm, tos.cfm, about.cfm) returned HTTP 403; content was reconstructed via search-engine snippet extraction and via the same operating entity's canonical privacy policy on constellation1.com, which is a reasonable but slightly lower-confidence substitute than a direct page fetch.

AI-training posture is unconfirmed at the vendor level: offrs.com embeds a third-party AI platform (raia) whose own site claims customer data is never used for external model training, but neither offrs.com's nor Constellation1's privacy policy independently states this for lead data processed through the integration.

No product-level trust center, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 evidence exists for offrs.com or Constellation1 specifically - all standard certs graded held=false with an honest 'no public evidence' basis, not an accusation of non-compliance.
